sum: Cyabra, Inc. provides technology solutions on a software as a service (SaaS) subscription basis. The company offers authenticity and behavior analysis, coordination and amplification analysis, multi-language narrative and sentiment intelligence, image and media analysis, real-time narrative alerts, deepfake detection, impersonation detection, and evidence-based mitigation solutions. It serves various industries, including banking and finance, retail and consumer goods, media and entertainment, PR agencies, public sector, and security and cyber. The company was incorporated in 2017 and is headquartered in Tel Aviv, Israel.
